About the Company

A Strategic Mining Intermediary

SELENA Investments is a Papua New Guinea–based investment and mining development company focused on structuring practical alluvial mining ventures through coordinated partnerships between developers, ML and AML holders, customary landowners, and regulators.

SELENA Investments is positioned as both a commercial project facilitator and a strategic mining intermediary — bridging developers, lease holders, landowners, and regulatory processes into workable mining structures.

Leadership

Founded & Led by Experience

Vanessa Panap
Founder & Managing Director

Vanessa Panap owns and leads SELENA Investments, providing strategic direction across project development, commercial structuring, and stakeholder coordination. She brings vast, hands-on experience in managing alluvial mining operations — encompassing management, coordination, logistics, finances, and overall administration.

Her role combines practical mining-sector engagement with direct exposure to district-linked resource development, giving SELENA Investments a commercially grounded understanding of how mining projects must be structured to move beyond opportunity and into execution.

What We Do

Comprehensive Mining Services

Selena Investment Ltd is a professional mining business consultancy and investment facilitation company committed to creating value for mining lease holders, resource owners, and investors by transforming mineral assets into structured, investable, and commercially viable business opportunities.

Operating Model

Four Core Principles

SELENA Investments operates as a structured mining development intermediary and commercial participant, built on a foundation that ensures every project is practically sound and commercially viable.

Local Alignment

Projects must be commercially aligned with local landowners and rights holders.

Practical Development

Projects must be operationally realistic, logistically executable, and commercially structured.

Regulatory Coordination

Projects must be positioned to move through regulatory pathways with stronger readiness and less friction.

Shared Participation

Mining development should create practical commercial participation across developers, investors, ML and AML holders, and landowners.

Vision & Positioning

Building Commercially Sound Mining Ventures

"SELENA Investments structures and develops practical alluvial mining ventures by aligning developers, ML and AML holders, landowners, capital, and regulatory access into commercially workable mining operations in Papua New Guinea."
